descriptions.owner: Full administrative control over business profile, team members, applications, legal disputes, and compliance sign-offs.
descriptions.complianceManager: Oversees standard compliance, regulatory radar, officer inspection visits, and compliance gap closures.
descriptions.documentationLead: Manages document vault, official scrutiny corrections, test report uploads, and undertakings.
descriptions.testingEngineer: Coordinates laboratory matching, sample test tracking, test parameter review, and STI compliance.
descriptions.financialOfficer: Manages certification fee payments, receipt reconciliation, and treasury compliances.
descriptions.auditorViewer: Read-only access to compliance chains, applications, and audit reports without modification rights.
